title: connector describe_attachment response, v0
description: 200 body of POST /v0/contributions/connector/describe_attachment: the exact size and SHA-256 of the bytes the plugin will upload, or a skip that leaves the attachment out of the item.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

skip.description: Why the attachment is left out, for example too_large when the bytes exceed attachments.max_bytes.

item_extensions.description: Replaces the item's extensions, for example to record the skipped attachment; in namespaces the plugin declares or the reserved quivr.metadata namespace (schema version 1).
